item.name: ⚙️ Environment Variables

request.description:
## Setup Guide

This is a documentation request. Do not send this request directly.

### Environment Variables

This collection uses the following variables:

| Variable | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | API base URL | `http://localhost:8000` |
| `authToken` | JWT access token (auto-set on login) | `eyJ...` |
| `jobId` | Job ID (auto-set on job creation) | `1` |

### Environments
- **Local**: `http://localhost:8000` — for local FastAPI development
- **Staging**: `https://staging.job-tracker.com` — for pre-production testing
- **Production**: `https://job-tracker.com` — live environment

### Quick Start
1. Select the **Local** environment
2. Run **Login** to auto-populate `authToken`
3. Run any authenticated request

### CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
Set `baseUrl` and `authToken` as GitHub Actions secrets and pass them to Newman runs.

item.description: Documentation and setup guide for environment variables used in this collection.
